Validate and save notification settings.

Performs partial update: only fields present in the request body are
changed.  If timezone is empty on the first write, the server's IANA
timezone is detected and persisted (Requirement 9.2).

The Notification_Engine SHALL NOT read the operating system timezone at
evaluation time — it always reads the persisted value (Requirement 9.3).

Selecting a node for the Alert_Node channel here IS the designation: the
save writes ``alert_receiver`` into that node's ``node_config.json``,
clears it from any node previously designated, and returns
``alert_node_deploy_notice`` when a restart is needed
(Requirements 5.12–5.15).  A node that is not ``transform_custom``, or that
does not live at the selected project and workflow, is rejected with 422
before anything is written.

Requirements: 9.2, 9.3, 5.12, 5.13, 5.14, 5.15, 6.6
